start.text: Add an email account to get started.

archive.missing: This account has no archive folder yet.

reader.remoteBlocked: Remote images are blocked to protect your privacy.
reader.blockedType: This file type can only be saved, not opened directly.

subs.empty: No newsletters found yet. redpanda recognizes them by the unsubscribe header they carry.
subs.stillComing_one: {{count}} more email arrived since. Some senders take a few days.
subs.stillComing_other: {{count}} more emails arrived since. Some senders take a few days.

unsub.title: Unsubscribe

how.one_click: redpanda asks {{target}} directly to stop sending these emails. There is nothing else to do.
how.mail: redpanda sends an email from {{account}} to {{target}} to unsubscribe you.
how.web: The unsubscribe page of {{target}} opens in your browser. You finish there.

unsub.pageOpened: Unsubscribe page opened in your browser

compose.title: New message
compose.subject: Subject
compose.fromUnavailable: This account may no longer send from that address. Pick another one under From.

wizard.title: Add account
wizard.name: Your name
wizard.namePlaceholder: Shown to the people you write to

detected.none: No settings found. Enter your server details below.

wizard.waitingBrowser: Finish signing in in your browser.
wizard.oauthMissing: This build of redpanda has no {{provider}} client ID. Add your own to sign in.
wizard.googleUnverified: Google will warn that it has not verified redpanda. Choose Advanced and then the link to redpanda to continue.

hint.google_app_password: Signing in with a password needs 2-step verification and an <url>app password from your Google account</url>.
hint.enable_imap_gmx: Turn on POP3/IMAP access in the GMX web mail settings first.
hint.enable_imap_webde: Turn on POP3/IMAP access in the WEB.DE web mail settings first.
hint.icloud_app_password: iCloud needs an app-specific password. Create one at <url>account.apple.com</url>.
hint.yahoo_app_password: Yahoo needs an app password. Create one in your <url>Yahoo account security settings</url>.
hint.tonline_mail_password: Use your separate email password, not the password of your Telekom login.

settings.title: Settings
settings.removeConfirm: Removes the account and its local copy. Nothing changes on the server.
settings.autoLoadImages: Always load external images (except in Spam)
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the notification area when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: New email keeps arriving. Quit from the icon next to the clock.
settings.autostartHint: redpanda starts in the notification area when you sign in, without a window.

claude.enableHint: Claude Code can then read and search the email of all accounts and send from your addresses. Only on this computer and only while redpanda runs.
claude.portInUse: Port {{port}} is in use. Pick another one below.
claude.portInvalid: The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
claude.connectText: Adds redpanda to Claude Code for your user. Then check with /mcp in a new Claude Code session.
claude.connected: redpanda was added to Claude Code
claude.notInstalled: The claude command was not found. Copy the command and run it yourself.
claude.keyHint: Whoever has the key can read and send your email through redpanda. It only works on this computer. Account passwords and sign-ins stay inside redpanda.
claude.rotated: New key. Add redpanda to Claude Code again.
claude.safety: Claude Code asks before every send. Don't allow send_mail permanently, so you see every email before it goes out.

update.installing: Downloading the update. redpanda restarts afterwards.
update.devBuild: Updates are only available in the installed version.

tray.hintBody: New email still arrives. To quit, right-click the icon in the notification area.

errors.db: The local database reported an error.
errors.imap: The mail server reported an error.
errors.smtp: The message could not be sent.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and the server settings.
errors.auth: Sign-in failed. Check the username and password.
errors.auth_required: This account needs you to sign in again.
errors.oauth_not_configured: No OAuth client ID is configured for this provider.
errors.secrets: The Windows Credential Manager could not be accessed.
errors.not_found: The message no longer exists on the server.
errors.no_archive_folder: This account has no archive folder.
